record.edic_text:
4723 steiros {sti'-ros}

a contraction from 4731 (as stiff and unnatural);; adj

AV - barren 4; 4

1) hard, stiff
   1a) of men and animals
2) barren
   2a) of woman who does not conceive

堅定的；固體（非液體狀食物），乾（飯）
